input.prompt: Edit this photo minimally. Every champagne bottle gets a plain blank cream label and plain gold foil — no yellow or orange labels, no crests, no writing. Remove any logo, crest, word, letter or number from buckets, glasses, mats, speakers and clothing. Change nothing else at all: keep every person, face, pose, object, tree, building, the sand, water, sky, light and framing exactly identical.
